labeler: Draft labels written by Claude (AI assistant, Claude Code) after reading every chunk in coherence_samples.csv and test_top3_records.csv; to be reviewed and confirmed by the author (Pham Nguyen Khoa). Labels were assigned per chunk text, independent of the automatic Hit@k flags.

scales.coherence: 0 = cut mid-idea or missing its subject, not understandable alone; 1 = partly understandable, missing context or cut at an edge; 2 = understandable alone and keeps a whole idea
scales.grounding: Judged on the union of the top-3 chunks. 0 = no evidence; 1 = some evidence but missing a needed condition or context; 2 = enough to answer and trace to the source page

coherence_sample_rule: First 10 counted pages sorted by (document_id, page); position = character midpoint of the normalized page text; the chunk covering that position is labeled. Fixed before looking at any score. B and C share the same chunks, so one label covers both.
